companyInfo.Footnote: A mutual company, not a stock company. It is grouped with stock companies because it reports according to Generally Accepted Accounting Principles.

description: GuideWell Mutual Holding is a health care organization that provides integrated health services and health insurance coverage for individuals, families, and groups across all 50 states, Puerto Rico, and the U.S. Virgin Islands. The company operates key subsidiaries such as Florida Blue (the largest health insurer in Florida) and Triple-S Management (a health care services provider in Puerto Rico), as well as GuideWell Health, GuideWell Source, and WebTPA. In addition, GuideWell supports government programs in processing Medicare claims.

rankings.title: Best Large Workplaces in Health Care
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say:

"We have management transparency, very few 'surprises', and management that is competent and thoughtful in decision making, all the way up the org chart. My team is as close to a work family as one could ask for.  I love the work I do with GuideWell, it provides me satisfaction for being a part of things that make a positive difference in people's lives.  I hope to continue contributing to this organization long into the future.  It is simply the best organization I have worked for, complete with opportunities to grow and lead!"
